options: A closed shape with 3 straight sides
A closed shape with 4 straight sides
questions.explanation: A triangle closes three straight sides into one shape.
questions.misconception: Four sides make a quadrilateral, two rays make an angle, and an endless path is a line — a triangle is exactly three sides.

questions.prompt: The three angles of any triangle add up to...
questions.explanation: No matter the shape, a triangle's angles sum to 180°.
questions.misconception: A single angle can be 90° and a quadrilateral sums to 360°, but the triangle total is always 180°.

questions.prompt: A triangle with all three sides equal is called...
questions.explanation: An equilateral triangle has three equal sides.
questions.misconception: Two equal sides is isosceles, no equal sides is scalene, and right is about angles — equilateral means all side lengths match.

questions.prompt: A triangle with one 90° angle is called...
questions.explanation: A triangle containing a right angle (90°) is a right triangle.
questions.misconception: Acute triangles have all angles under 90°, obtuse triangles have one over 90° — the presence of a perfect right angle makes it a right triangle.

questions.prompt: Why are triangles used in bridges and roofs?
options: They are rigid and won't bend out of shape
They are the cheapest to paint
questions.explanation: Triangles lock their angles in place, so they resist being pushed out of shape.
questions.misconception: Rigidity is the reason — quadrilaterals flex, which is why frames are braced by triangles.
